title: 教程与实际操作不一致
description: 教程中展示的操作方式在实际游戏中无法使用，导致玩家困惑。
evidence: The opening tutorial shows you how to control the hand and fingers. Then it turns out you can't do that in the game, and just press letters for thoughts.

evidence_items.quote: The opening tutorial shows you how to control the hand and fingers. Then it turns out you can't do that in the game, and just press letters for thoughts.
evidence_items.description: 教程展示手和手指的控制，但实际游戏中无法使用，只能按字母键
evidence_items.quote_zh: 开头的教程向你展示如何控制手和手指。结果在游戏里你根本不能那么做，只能按字母来产生想法。
